You can fill in this form in any language. Partial runs and unsuccessful attempts
are useful too.

## Environment

AEA tag or commit, operating system and version, CPU architecture (for example,
Apple Silicon or Intel), and relevant Python/MNE or MATLAB/EEGLAB versions.
If you used an agent, include its client version and model name. Do not include
an API key or account credentials.

## Instructions and route

Link the instructions you followed and name the route: Python/MNE, EEGLAB with
MNE, native MATLAB, fixed tutorial, saved-result replay, or another documented
path. Link public or synthetic data if you used any.

## Steps actually tried

Describe which steps you completed: environment setup, client launch, analysis,
output checks, or replay. For each step tried, give the outcome. Leave untested
steps identified as untested.

## Results and evidence

Describe the outputs or errors. Attach shareable logs, screenshots, or check
results. If you checked numbers or replayed results, include the command and
actual outcome. Opening a report alone does not check its numerical content.

## Manual changes and confusing steps

What did you have to change or do by hand? Which instructions could be clearer?
Keep failures and incomplete steps in the report.

Before posting, remove personal information and private participant data from
logs, screenshots and outputs. Share data-access instructions rather than
restricted datasets.
